title: HiSilicon Hi3650 (Kirin 950) Application Processor TSMC 16FF+ 9-Track CPU Library Standard Cell Essentials
lineage: Public synopsis of independent reverse engineering. It gives the marketed handset model but leaves the regional SKU and exact sample provenance unspecified.

passages.note: The analysts identify a Hi3650 (Kirin 950) extracted from a Huawei Mate 8 as TSMC 16FF+ high-k metal gate FinFET CMOS, and report analysing its CPU standard cells and interconnect stack.
